discription: A warm, evolving pad sound with a subtle pulsating texture, using two detuned sine waves and a low-pass filter, plus a touch of reverb.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, detune=0.005, cutoff=4000, rq=0.5, reverbMix=0.2;var sig, env, pulseLFO, lfoFreq = 0.5;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 2.0, 0.7, 3.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2);pulseLFO = SinOsc.kr(lfoFreq) * 0.1 + 0.9;sig = (SinOsc.ar(freq) + SinOsc.ar(freq * (1 + detune))) * 0.5;sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff + (pulseLFO * 200));sig = sig * amp * env * pulseLFO;sig = FreeVerb.ar(sig, mix: reverbMix, room: 0.8, damp: 0.5);Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
